purpose: Independent-seed reject-only confirmation of the fixed alpha-0.50 Qwen3.5 LoRA interpolation

selection_time_rationale.fold_0: Experiment 430 changed decisions and produced a small positive effect on this fold
selection_time_rationale.fold_3: Experiment 430 produced its largest positive effect and recall recovery on this fold

changed_factor: Training seed only: repeat the exact experiment-260 specialist recipe and interpolate it with the original adapter from the same seed
alpha_selection: fixed from experiment 430; no grid or tuning on seed-31415 predictions
threshold_rule: The same fold-specific threshold transferred from experiment 430 is applied to the pure specialist and the soup; no seed-31415 labels select a threshold
limitations: Passing authorizes a separately versioned full cycle only. The two-fold result cannot itself accept, package, or submit a model.
